bullets: Closed an XSS vector in rendered source links by validating untrusted backend responses at the API client boundary, dropping any URL outside HTTP/HTTPS.

Built Playwright verification scripts that drive the running app against a failing backend and report which of the 25 instrumented paths actually emit Sentry events, catching miswired instrumentation before an incident does.

tech: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Node.js, Vercel
